docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-04-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JAN-13-2023 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF/ CROSS DEFENDANT CENTRAL FAMILY TRUST IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY JUDITH PASQUINELLI (TRUSTEE) WITH WITNESS ROBERT LOMELI (HILL & COMPANY, PROPERTY MANAGER). DEFENDANT/ CROSS COMPLAINANT JOHN LEE IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT'S CROSSCLAIM. PLAINTIFF/ CROSS DEFENDANT CENTRAL FAMILY TRUST WAIVES SERVICE ON CROSSCLAIM.
